neighbours.label: The word intake in statements about nutritional consumption
fire: Reducing portion sizes lowers your intake of fat over the week.
The dietitian asked her to record her daily intake of protein.
Skipping breakfast can affect your intake of essential nutrients.
The study compared average intake of fiber across the two diets.
Adding beans to dinner increases the family's intake of iron.
The meal plan provides a steady intake of calories throughout the day.
Participants measured their intake of sugar during the trial.
The nutrition chart lists the recommended intake of sodium.
quiet: Reducing portion sizes lowers your consumption of fat over the week.
The dietitian asked her to record her daily consumption of protein.
Skipping breakfast can affect your consumption of essential nutrients.
The study compared average consumption of fiber across the two diets.
Adding beans to dinner increases the family's consumption of iron.

Participants measured their consumption of sugar during the trial.

notes: Card examples are heterogeneous; intake and fasting suggest a nutritional subpattern but do not justify a general topic label. Controls keep nutrition and replace intake with consumption. This is a deliberately narrow, low-confidence hypothesis. Codex-authored; cards only.
